standard-dialogue-mime-show-version.npc: Hey, [player name], would you like to come and perform in a mime show?

options.text: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.

steps.player: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.

steps.text: Player is teleported to the mime show random event.

steps.npc: You need to copy the mime's performance, then you'll be returned to where you were.

standard-dialogue-maze-version.npc: Hey, [player name], would you like to come and solve a maze for me?

steps.text: Player is teleported to the maze.

steps.npc: Reach the maze centre as fast as possible. The faster you are, the better your reward.

standard-dialogue-hand-out-item-version.npc: Ah, so you are there. I hoped you would talk to me, I get so lonely. Here, have a present! I must be going now though.

standard-dialogue-hand-out-item-version.text: If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.text: Your reward is [Reward] - it has been placed on the ground.

if-the-event-is-not-yours.npc: Sorry, I'm trying to speak to someone else, but [he/she/they] seems to be ignoring me.

random-event-overhead-dialogue.text: Upon spawning in for the player & waiting for a response by the player:

steps.npc: I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!

random-event-overhead-dialogue.text: If the player does not respond in time:

crack-the-clue-ii.text: If the incorrect conditions are met:

steps.npc: I'm sorry, but you are no use to me.

crack-the-clue-ii.text: If the correct conditions are met:

steps.npc: Here, take this. But tell no one I was here.

crack-the-clue-iii.npc: Well done! I have new information to share with you.

crack-the-clue-iii.text: You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!
Interface showing the next clue opens.

crack-the-clue-iii-entering-the-bank-vau.npc: Well done! It's time to take your reward!

crack-the-clue-iii-entering-the-bank-vau.text: The player is teleported into the vault as the old man teleports away.
